subtasks: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
Pick up only the rightmost bread slice on the rack and place it upright in the toaster's right slot.
Pick up only the rightmost remaining bread slice from the rack and place it upright into the empty right toaster slot, leaving the first slice in the left slot.
Press the lever on the front of the filled toaster fully down, then release it, open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
